result.summary: Found 2 major issues: a missing/broken restaurant image in the Popular right now section and a horizontally cut-off restaurant card in the Fastest near you section.

issues.description: Restaurant image failed to load in the 'Popular right now' section, showing a placeholder icon instead of actual restaurant photo
issues.suggestion: Implement proper error handling for failed image loads and ensure all restaurant images are properly linked and cached. Consider showing a fallback image or skeleton loader while images load.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off on the right side of the screen
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel/scroll container width and padding to ensure all visible cards are fully displayed without horizontal overflow, or implement proper horizontal scrolling with visible scroll indicators
